scope: Complete 2977-prime bank through 12 crossings. Representative pilot queries for first and last corpus types at each crossing count 9 through 12, three fresh independent eight-step scrambles per selected type. The eight selected bank representatives also independently scrambled eight steps; the remaining 2969 bank embeddings are canonical. Fixed permutations, no discarded/replaced cases. Labels, counts, seeds and histories stay outside the classifier. All lattice move locations remain unrestricted. This is not exhaustive query coverage of the 2977 types.

proofArchive.compression: Original concatenated gzip members; joining parts reproduces the original archive SHA256.

lanes.nodeAccountingScope: Geometric expansions and relaxed proof/validation nodes are separate units. Elapsed lane totals include both.

costScope: Lane elapsed includes all queries, full root domains, wrong references, failed contours, online learning, validation, certificate replay, cold initialization, and proof archival/checkpoints. Common preparation and independent audit separately reported. Prior-stage costs retained in combined reporting.
artifactScope: Lossless per-query gzip JSON includes complete root graph, every attempted search contour, learned-cost snapshots and any positive certificate. Each artifact is hash-bound by its manifest stub. Gzip JSONL proof archive parts preserve their original concatenated compressed bytes.
